page_title: Mac Classic Player — a Media Player Classic alternative for macOS

summary.name: Mac Classic Player
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source macOS media player for Apple Silicon that brings Media Player Classic's keyboard controls to the Mac.
use_cases: Playing local video files on a Mac
Playing local audio files on a Mac
Replacing Media Player Classic on macOS
summary.what_it_does: Opens files by drag-and-drop or the O key, with no library import step. Playback controls (play, stop, seek, volume, mute, fullscreen, file list navigation) are all mapped to keyboard keys, and pressing ? shows the full list. It plays .mov, .mp4, .webm video and .mp3, .m4a, .wav audio. Pressing I shows track title, artist, album and year. Volume and window size are saved on quit and restored on next launch.
notable: Keyboard controls copied from Media Player Classic
Restores volume and window size between sessions
Drag-and-drop or O key to open files with no library setup
caveats: Built for Apple Silicon Macs only
Supported formats are limited to the listed video and audio types
